verdict.rationale: Qualcomm's own AI stack documents deploying models to the Hexagon NPU on Snapdragon X-series PCs: the AI Engine Direct SDK and AI Hub, plus GenieX, a unified runtime for NPU, GPU and CPU. AI Hub also converts models to ONNX Runtime and Qualcomm AI Runtime. However, none of this evidence names the X2 Elite Extreme specifically; the docs refer only to the X-series generically. Missing for 10: explicit X2 Elite Extreme support in runtime docs, any evidence of llama.cpp or MLX support, an ONNX Runtime execution-provider page for this chip, and independent or hands-on confirmation that these runtimes run on it.

support.subject: As a developer, mainstream local-AI runtimes target this silicon — llama.cpp, MLX, ONNX Runtime, or the vendor's own AI software stack document support for its CPU, GPU, or NPU

citations.quote: the Qualcomm AI Engine Direct SDK, and Qualcomm AI Hub for optimizing and deploying models to the Hexagon NPU on Snapdragon X-series PCs
